dynamic-040-gridjs-io-docs.content_text:
Hello, World!

You can interact with the following editor!

const grid = new Grid({ columns: ['Name', 'Email', 'Phone Number'], data: [ ['John', 'john@example.com', '(353) 01 222 3333'], ['Mark', 'mark@gmail.com', '(01) 22 888 4444'] ] });

Name Email Phone Number

John john@example.com (353) 01 222 3333

Mark mark@gmail.com (01) 22 888 4444

Or you can update the config using updateConfig:

const grid = new Grid({ data: [ ['John', 'john@example.com', '(353) 01 222 3333'], ['Mark', 'mark@gmail.com', '(01) 22 888 4444'] ] }).updateConfig({ columns: ['Name', 'Email', 'Phone Number'], });
